name: OmaFlow
author: Tempest
description: Air and liquid cooling from the Omarchy bar. Four locked cooling modes plus a custom NZXT-CAM-style curve, CPU/GPU telemetry, and Kraken LCD theming.

barWidget.description: CPU and GPU temps in the bar, with fan, pump, and AIO curves in a details panel.

schema.label: Control GPU fans
schema.description: Off (default): the NVIDIA driver keeps its own fan curve. On: OmaFlow drives the GPU fans with the selected mode.

schema.label: Control AIO radiator fans
schema.description: Off (default): leave AIO fan headers alone — use this if those fans are on a hub or motherboard header. On: push the AIO fan curve through liquidctl.

schema.label: Sync AIO display with the theme accent
schema.description: Tint the AIO LCD and LEDs with the Omarchy accent. Liquid temp is redrawn in that color because the stock firmware display is white and not tintable.

schema.label: Pump display
schema.description: Kraken LCD mode. Liquid shows coolant temperature. Accent paints the theme color. Off blanks the screen.
